verdicts.title: Algorithms in Real Algebraic Geometry: A Survey
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We survey both old and new developments in the theory of algorithms in real algebraic geometry -- starting from effective quantifier elimination in the first order theory of reals due to Tarski and Seidenberg, to more recent algorithms for computing topological invariants of semi-algebraic sets. We emphasize throughout the complexity aspects of these algorithms and also discuss the computational hardness of the underlying problems. verdicts.title: Equiresidual algebraic geometry I: The affine theory

verdicts.title: Machine Learning Algebraic Geometry for Physics
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We review some recent applications of machine learning to algebraic geometry and physics. Since problems in algebraic geometry can typically be reformulated as mappings between tensors, this makes them particularly amenable to supervised learning. Additionally, unsupervised methods can provide insight into the structure of such geometrical data.
